title: Zoo Scene 7 — Animals in Different Places
purpose: Support habitat talk, location language and simple observation in a wildlife-park scene.

sentenceModels: The penguin is near the pool.
The lion is in the shade.
The monkey is on the branch.
The elephant is by the water.

adultSupport.focus: Talk about where animals are and why those places suit them.
starterPrompts: Which animal is by the water?
Who is resting in the shade?
Which animal is on the branch?
expansionPrompts: Why might the lion like the shade?
Tell me where each animal is in the zoo.

visualAudit: Reviewed in Wave 3 Batch 3 automatic pass against the main teaching targets.
